instruction: I want to set up a global keyboard shortcut for play/pause in VLC so I can control playback even when the window is not focused. Please configure this feature.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling global keyboard shortcut for play/pause in VLC. The evaluator checks if global-key-play-pause is configured (non-empty value) in the VLC configuration file. Similar configuration task requiring VLC hotkey settings navigation.
metadata.verification: Verified using existing check_global_key_play_pause metric function. Expected: global-key-play-pause has a non-empty value (metric returns 1) in vlcrc.
